从动手搭建，到一起复盘。: From hands-on builds to team debriefs.
一楼练习场承接机器人行驶、操作与配合训练，让搭建后的方案回到场地中反复验证。: On the ground-floor practice field, teams train drivers, rehearse robot operations and practise working together. Each new build goes back on the field for testing.
搭建区连接工具区和存储区，围绕零件整理、机构装配与机器人维护组织日常工程工作。: The build area connects to the tool and storage areas, so teams can organise parts, assemble mechanisms and maintain their robots in one place.
交流区用于队员讨论和协作，展示区呈现作品与阶段成果；休息区为连续训练留出调整节奏: Teammates meet and work together in the discussion area, share finished and in-progress work in the display area, and take breaks in the lounge during long practice sessions.
二楼设置教室、会议室与办公区，支持课程学习、方案讲解、赛季复盘与日常团队协作。: Upstairs, a classroom, meeting room and offices give teams space for lessons, design presentations, season reviews and day-to-day collaboration.

本科毕业于哥伦比亚大学计算机科学与物理专业，后于斯坦福大学深造。: Theo earned an undergraduate degree in computer science and physics at Columbia University before pursuing graduate studies at Stanford.
学生时代参与 FRC 并两次夺冠，长期致力于推动中国科技教育的发展。: A two-time FRC champion as a student, Theo has long worked to advance technology education in China.

自 2017 年以来，连续九年获得 FRC 中国区总冠军，并多次获得 VEX R: Since 2017, Steve has won nine consecutive FRC China championships and multiple national titles in the VEX Robotics Competition and RoboMaster.
累计培养 500+ 学生参与机器人竞赛并进入世界名校。现负责 FoundryX: Steve has coached more than 500 students who have competed in robotics and gone on to leading universities worldwide. At FoundryX, Steve leads technical programmes, curriculum development and competition coaching.

擅长将互联网大厂的敏捷开发思维引入教学，教会学生不仅写代码，更要创造产品和解决问: Adrian brings agile development practices from the tech industry into the classroom, teaching students to build products and solve problems through code. At FoundryX, Adrian develops software courses and coaches competition teams.

本科毕业于哥伦比亚大学金融工程专业，后于斯坦福大学攻读 MBA。: Michael earned an undergraduate degree in financial engineering at Columbia University before pursuing an MBA at Stanford.
有多年硅谷科技 VC 经验，参与调研大量科技商业项目。现负责 FoundryX: Michael spent years in Silicon Valley venture capital, evaluating a wide range of technology ventures. At FoundryX, Michael develops technology business courses and advises teams on management.
曾带队五次获得 FTC 中国区总冠军。: Denghai has coached teams to five FTC China championships.
曾担任取得 FTC 世锦赛中国队最佳成绩的战队主教练，带队经历覆盖中国区赛事与世: As head coach, Denghai led a team to the best result achieved by a Chinese team at the FTC World Championship. Denghai’s experience spans national and world championship events.
将国内外赛场的带队经验带入学生的学习与成长，为有志于挑战 FTC 赛事的学生提供: Drawing on competitions in China and abroad, Denghai guides students preparing for FTC as they combine engineering with teamwork and develop their skills through competition.
浙江大学计算机系毕业: Zhejiang University graduate in computer science
前中国商飞（COMAC）资深工程师，技术背景横跨机械设计、电路系统与嵌入式软件。: A former senior engineer at COMAC, Xing has worked across mechanical design, electrical systems and embedded software.
曾深度参与 C919 等国产大飞机的系统设计与集成工作，具备从整体系统出发理解各: Xing worked extensively on system design and integration for Chinese commercial aircraft, including the C919. In robotics classes, that experience helps students see how mechanical, electronic and software components work together.
推崇“大工程”思维，引导学生贯通结构、电路与程序设计，关注各技术环节的配合与约束: Xing teaches students to think at the scale of the whole system, connecting structures, circuits and code and examining how each constrains the others. A focus on reliability and stability helps them move from individual functions to a complete, coordinated robot.
具备自动化与机器人领域的专业背景，拥有六年 FRC 与 VEX 教学经验。: With a background in automation and robotics, Yejie has six years of experience teaching FRC and VEX.
曾带领学生多次获得 VEX 中国区冠军。熟悉材料力学与精密减速器原理，在机械教学: Yejie has coached students to multiple VEX China championships. Drawing on mechanics of materials and precision gearing, Yejie helps students understand loads, transmissions and how design decisions affect robot performance.
指导学生运用工业级 CAD 建模与仿真工具，将创意逐步转化为可分析、可验证的结构: Yejie teaches students to turn ideas into structures they can analyse and test with industrial CAD and simulation tools. By taking a concept through modelling and fabrication, students learn to build robust robots that work in practice.

在多模态人工智能系统全国重点实验室开展研究，研发 Casia Hand 系列灵巧: At the State Key Laboratory of Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems, Peng develops the Casia Hand series and robots with human-like dexterity, studying how robots grasp and pass objects and use tools.
曾赴慕尼黑工业大学、加州大学伯克利分校访问研究。获北京市科学技术奖、中国自动化学: Peng has held visiting research positions at the Technical University of Munich and UC Berkeley. Honours include the Beijing Science and Technology Award, first prize in the Chinese Association of Automation’s Technological Invention Award, and a gold medal at the International Exhibition of Inventions Geneva.
关注如何将人工智能用于解决真实场景中的问题。: Yuanzhe explores how AI can solve real-world problems.
在斯坦福大学攻读机械工程硕士，学习方向涉及机器人。关注深度学习在计算机视觉与自然: Yuanzhe’s master’s studies in mechanical engineering at Stanford include robotics. Research interests include deep learning for computer vision and natural language processing.
拥有 NVIDIA 与 Landing AI 工作经历，将机器学习研究与实际工程: At NVIDIA and Landing AI, Yuanzhe connected machine learning research with practical engineering applications.
得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校博士生: PhD student, The University of Texas at Austin
研究机器人灵巧操作，师从 Roberto Martín-Martín。: Bob studies dexterous robot manipulation with Roberto Martín-Martín.
曾在卡内基梅隆大学机器人研究所攻读硕士，师从 David Held，研究强化学习: Bob pursued a master’s at Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute, studying reinforcement learning and robot manipulation with David Held. Bob earned an undergraduate degree in engineering at Harvey Mudd College and also studied visual arts.
研究围绕灵巧操作、工具使用与操作技能学习展开，代表工作包括 CoDex、HACM: Bob studies dexterous manipulation, tool use and how robots learn manipulation skills. Projects include CoDex, HACMan++ and HACMan, with work published at ICRA, RSS and CoRL.
办学初衷 · FoundryX·为中国培养下一代科技领袖: Our Story · FoundryX · Shaping China’s Next Generation of Tech Leaders
在美国求学与工作的十年间，项目式学习、开放的创新文化，以及产学研的紧密协作，让我: During my ten years studying and working in the US, I saw the impact of project-based learning, an open culture of innovation and close collaboration between industry and academia. I founded FoundryX to bring the approach to engineering education I encountered in Silicon Valley and at Stanford back to China. I wanted more young people to work on industry-scale engineering projects, learn by doing and build their own ideas.
我们选择 FRC 作为这段旅程的起点。比起一场比赛的胜负，我更珍视学生从构想到设: We chose FRC as our starting point. What I value most is how students grow as they turn an idea into a design and learn from failed attempts. They find the courage to ask questions, learn to work together and solve problems through trial and error. As they build things themselves, they gain confidence and discover what they want to pursue.

在苏州外国语学校发起成立机器人社团，先后参加两届 FRC 中国夏令营及两次 CR: We started a robotics club at Suzhou Foreign Language School, taking part in two FRC China summer camps and two CRC robotics competitions. Our exploration of robotics and engineering began with hands-on work at school.
6394战队正式成立，同年在 FRC 中国季后赛中夺得队史首个全国冠军。: Team 6394 was officially formed and won its first national title at the FRC China Offseason that year.
再度登顶 FRC 中国季后赛，成功卫冕全国冠军，实现两连冠。: The team defended its title at the FRC China Offseason, winning back-to-back national championships.
创始人赴美求学期间，团队持续支持上海平和中学、复旦附中及华东师大二附中的 FRC: While our founder studied in the US, the team continued to help build and train FRC teams at Shanghai Pinghe School, High School Affiliated to Fudan University and No. 2 High School of East China Normal University. The teams won multiple national titles and honours at international events.
创立 FoundryX，与多所国际学校开展科创课程及竞赛合作，将多年积累的教育与: We founded FoundryX and partnered with several international schools on technology courses and competitions, bringing years of teaching and engineering experience to more students. We coached Shanghai Pinghe School to victory at the FRC China Regional. Teams from Suzhou Foreign Language School, Huili School Shanghai and Shanghai Pinghe School also swept the top three places at the China Offseason under our guidance.
下一段传奇，期待与你共同创造。: We look forward to writing the next chapter with you.
